Name: Easy Mode Store
Author: NightBlade561
Description:
Tired of dying in Skull Cavern? Can't seem to get your hands on some batteries? Then this is the mod for you!

The Easy Mode Store mod extends Pierre's store with a few items which are difficult to get, and makes them available at affordable prices. As of the basic version, Pierre's store includes:

[list]
[*]5 irridium ores @ 100g each
[*]1 battery @ 250g
[*]10 wild bait @ 5g each
[/list]
Additionally, to make bundles easier, Pierre's store sells the following items all the time, at their regular prices:
[list]
[*]Pumpkin seeds
[*]Poppy seeds
[*]Melon seeds
[*]Wheat seeds
[*]Red cabbage seedsu
[*]Fiddlehead fern
[*]Truffle
[*]Rabbit's foot
[/list]
[b]For players who want more challenge,[/b] the same 11 items are available at the JojaMart, three randomly picked each day.

I highly recommend you install the Crops Anytime Anywhere mod so you can farm these without waiting for the appropriate season.

If you have any item requests, please let us know so we can consider adding more things to the store!

[b]I don't check the bugs tab often[/b], so if you have any questions, comments, suggestions, bug reports, etc. please open an issue against the [url=https://github.com/deengames/stardew-valley-easy-mode-store/issues]GitHub repository[/url].

Downloads.Description: Fixes an issue where the mod zip file doesn't work with Nexus Mod Manager (the root directory of the mod is missing).
